BiblicalUsage: The word is the completion of a harvest, the wealth of produce, and it appears once, in Eliphaz's warning that the wicked man's riches will not last: he shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning stands even when the speaker is wrong about Job: wealth that is not rooted in God does not continue.
